title: BAGMAN XeroAccountSuggestion
description: One AI-produced, non-authoritative proposal of which Xero chart-of-accounts entry a piece of eligible evidence should be coded to (`xero/account-suggestion-producer` WO). Append-only ledger row — never mutated, never itself an authoritative coding decision. `status` is always `REVIEW_REQUIRED` at creation: an AI-produced suggestion is NEVER created with any other status (mirrors `EvidenceClassification`'s own AI_PROPOSAL discipline). The real, write-once authoritative decision is a SEPARATE record, `XeroAccountAssignment` (`bagman.xero_account_assignment.v1`), created only by a human operator's resolution of the Needs You item this suggestion raises.

suggestion_id.description: Canonical BAGMAN identifier for this suggestion row.

evidence_id.description: The `EvidenceItem` this suggestion was produced for.

entity_id.description: The BAGMAN `GovernedEntity` this suggestion was produced for — copied verbatim from the evidence's own already-resolved `entity_id` at creation time, never re-derived later (mirrors how `EvidenceItem.entity_id` itself is set once and trusted).

tenant_id.description: The Xero organisation/tenant (`XeroConnection.tenant_id` / `XeroAccount.tenant_id`'s own identifier) this suggestion's candidate account set was drawn from — the same field name/shape `XeroAccount` already uses for this identity, deliberately reused rather than inventing a second name for the same concept.

suggested_account_id.description: The Xero `AccountID` the AI proposed — already validated, before this row is ever created, against the real eligible-account set supplied to the model (`services.xero.ai_suggestion.resolve_ai_suggested_account`).

confidence.description: The model's self-reported confidence (mirrors `EvidenceClassification.confidence`'s own AI_PROPOSAL shape) — never a manufactured value.

signals.description: Short, evidence-based justifications the model gave for this suggestion (from the AIInvocation output's own `signals` field) — bounded short strings, never raw document content.

ai_invocation_id.description: The `AIInvocation` that produced this suggestion — full provenance back to exactly which governed AI run this came from.

status.description: Always `REVIEW_REQUIRED` — an AI-produced suggestion is never created with any other status (see this schema's own top-level description). No transition/status-change exists on this row at all; a human decision is recorded on the separate `XeroAccountAssignment` record instead.
